# Dune planet: r 1.5 sand ball, crater rims, three cacti, a pyramid. Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Sand --base-color 0.8706 0.5922 0.3176 --no-slot
material new Crater --base-color 0.7137 0.4078 0.1922 --no-slot
material new Cactus --base-color 0.0314 0.6980 0.2314 --no-slot
material new Pyramid --base-color 0.9843 0.7451 0.5098 --no-slot
add mesh ico-sphere --name Dune --subdivisions 2 --radius 1.5
material assign Sand
active Dune
mode edit
select face where "normal.y > 0.3"
delete only-faces
select all
randomize --amount 0.05 --seed 5
mode object
add mesh torus --name Crater0 --major-segments 8 --minor-segments 4 --major-radius 0.32 --minor-radius 0.09 --location 0.729 -1.134 0.612 --rotation 0 65.60 -57.27
scale 1 1 0.6
material assign Crater

scale 1 1 0.6
material assign Crater
add mesh torus --name Crater2 --major-segments 8 --minor-segments 4 --major-radius 0.39 --minor-radius 0.09 --location 0.370 -1.282 -0.641 --rotation 0 115.66 -73.90
scale 1 1 0.6
material assign Crater
add mesh torus --name Crater3 --major-segments 8 --minor-segments 4 --major-radius 0.32 --minor-radius 0.09 --location -0.313 -1.341 0.542 --rotation 0 68.53 -103.12
scale 1 1 0.6
material assign Crater

material assign Cactus
add mesh cylinder --name Arm2 --vertices 6 --radius 0.09 --depth 0.3 --location -0.456 0.000 -1.750 --rotation 0 160.00 -180.00
material assign Cactus
add mesh cone --name Pyramid --vertices 4 --radius1 0.5 --radius2 0 --depth 0.55 --location 0 0 0 --rotation 0 0 45
